root_cause: The file-discovery cleanup predicate treated an absent S7 target as sufficient, even while a Prometheus restart had not yet reloaded the five frozen baseline targets.
Each diagnostic therefore recorded a transient zero-target and zero-UP baseline immediately after restart, so its cleanup evidence was incomplete despite later runtime recovery.
remediation: Freeze and verify the five-target Prometheus baseline before any S7 mutation.
Require both an absent S7 target and exactly five of five baseline targets UP before cleanup can converge.
Make diagnostic and acceptance paths fail closed when source serving, lease, or Prometheus cleanup evidence is incomplete.
Add positive and negative regressions for the transient zero-target state and exact cleanup contract.
claim_boundary: Rejected controlled local single-node diagnostics with zero S7 acceptance credit; no production, SLA, HA/DR, multi-GPU, or broad model-quality claim.
